question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**used**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses Santosh Bisen’s method of making science chapters easier to understand for students.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate the action Bisen took with his drawing skills.
 
• **"Used"** fits well as it denotes employing his drawing skills to create comic strips, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options (**"maintained"**, **"depicted"**, **"reformed"**) do not fit the context of describing how he applied his drawing skills for educational purposes.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: * **Santosh Bisen, science teacher and cartoonist at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Durg, Chhattisgarh used__ his drawing (2)________ to convert chapters into comic strips. "Convincing authorities to turn textbooks into comics was difficult. I spent my own money to (3)________ textbooks. I also used cartoons in question papers," he says. "Students were (4)________ with how simple science became and their performance (5)_________," he adds. *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Maintained **(बनाए रखा): "Maintained" means to keep something in existence, which does not fit the context of using drawing skills to innovate.
 
• **Depicted **(चित्रण): "Depicted" means to show or represent, which does not fully capture the action of intentionally applying skills to create comic strips.
 
• **Reformed **(सुधार किया): "Reformed" means to make changes to improve something, which does not fit the context of how he utilized his drawing skills.
